composite.note: 3 ordered steps in one episode. Every step before the last is judged by its engine predicate on live/fresh samples (a carried object's goal is re-checked against its current pose), the last by the loaded scene's native goal; each placing step also needs a measured release, and the final sample must show nothing still gripped

plan.interpretation: One scene, 3 ordered capabilities (put_cream_cheese_in_bowl -> put_bowl_on_stove -> turn_on_stove). The episode is loaded from task 7 (turn_on_stove) and is never reset between steps; each step receives its own catalog official instruction.
plan.success_condition: Every step's own goal must hold on fresh samples of the same episode after step 3: steps 1..2 by their engine predicates, step 3 by the loaded scene's native LIBERO goal; every step that places an object must also show a measured release.
